test_shard_op_basic: test the shard operation on a data pipeline with even distribution across shards
test_shard_op_uneven: test the shard operation with allow_uneven set to true for uneven shard distribution
test_shard_invalid_idx: test that shard raises ValueError when shard_idx is greater than or equal to num_shards
test_shard_state_save_restore: test saving and restoring pipeline state using state_dict and load_state_dict methods
test_shard_reset: test resetting a sharded data pipeline back to its initial position
